design.adjudicator_role: adjudicates disagreements; not counted as a fourth independent rater

metric_definitions.quadratic_weighted_kappa: Pairwise Cohen kappa with squared ordinal distance over fixed levels 1-6.
metric_definitions.krippendorff_alpha_ordinal: Three-rater Krippendorff alpha with ordinal distance and fixed value domain 1-6.
metric_definitions.interval_overlap: Share of inclusive low-high intervals with non-empty pairwise intersection.
metric_definitions.interval_iou: Mean intersection-over-union of inclusive integer intervals.
metric_definitions.evidence_page_jaccard: Mean Jaccard similarity of normalized evidence-page sets.

uncertainty.dimension_all_rule: Resample books, retaining all ten dimensions within each sampled book.
